title: Book 1: Analog Heart & Teenager in the Valley (1978–1989)
description: From fourteen-year-old Ryan O'Connell's sensory frequencies at Blacksburg High School in September 1978 and the ten-person family household at 124 Draper Road, to Aunt Martha Wright's farmhouse on Progress Street NE, the writing of 'The Stardust Engine,' and sixteen-year-old Holly's $1.00 Cross-License.
